purpose: Register terminal non-implemented SGC concepts without duplicating their concept-level authority or reopening resolved source/owner decisions.

exception_classes.meaning: Governed content, source-preserved facts or explicit content gaps that do not assert executable runtime implementation.
exception_classes.closure_rule: Remain discoverable through the originating SGC leaf artifact and exact owner/content route; absent facts stay unknown and are not fabricated.

exception_classes.meaning: Terminally routed future work with an exact existing/planned owner or owner composition and no authority activated by SGC.
exception_classes.closure_rule: The owner/destination remains exact and gated; SGC does not create a shadow implementation queue or activate the destination.

exception_classes.meaning: Retained provenance/shared-invariant/source-review evidence that creates no implementation or content-definition obligation.
exception_classes.closure_rule: Preserve discoverability and provenance only; do not promote, bind or infer gameplay/content facts from the retained evidence.

authority_rule: This register is a class/count and handling index only. Concept IDs, source_refs, owners, evidence and terminal overrides remain authoritative in SGC_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PRODUCT_DISPOSITION_TRACE_GRAPH.json and the originating SGC evidence artifacts.

forward_route_guards.ARI: ARI-01..22 after SGC-08; not activated here
forward_route_guards.SAA: SAA-01..20 after SMB-09; not activated here
forward_route_guards.P3D: owner-approved deferred future project; no automatic activation
